about: Corrections and additions to data/atlas.json, kept here so they survive a rebuild with tools/build_atlas.py. 'fix' changes fields of existing records (kind, cls = main pose class, alt = other pose classes the sculpture can also stand for). 'records' are new models (mesh m/<id>.js, thumbnail t/<id>.webp). A new record is skipped if atlas.json already has its id.

records.desc: A veiled, draped goddess seated upright on a throne; the forearms are broken off. Scan of the plaster cast in the Royal Cast Collection, Copenhagen.
records.poseRaw: Seated upright on a throne, knees apart under heavy drapery, head veiled
records.credit: Unknown ancient artist; plaster cast KAS128, Statens Museum for Kunst, National Gallery of Denmark; original marble, British Museum, Demeter of Knidos. Scan supplied by SMK.
